run_gemini_baseline: run the gemini-pro baseline on an open-eqa dataset using the CLI with --dataset and --model flags
run_dry_run: run a dry run of the gemini-pro baseline processing only the first 5 questions with --dry-run
ask_question_gemini: ask a single question to the Gemini Pro model and get a parsed answer using ask_question
parse_gemini_output: parse the Gemini model output string to extract the answer after the A: prefix
resume_results: resume processing from existing results by passing an output path that already contains partial answers
